title: Fill pull compensation 0.5 mm lengthens each row end by 0.5 mm (under sewing on)
description: A 40 × 40 mm fill at 0°, density 4.5, pull compensation 0.5 mm, under sewing on: the top rows are 2 × pull wider than the square, the under sewing is not compensated (its edge run stays 1 mm inside), as in PE-DESIGN's file.

evidence.note: Fill Stitch: Density, Pull compensation, Under sewing

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw a 40 × 40 mm square with the Rectangle tool from (10, 10) to (50, 50) mm. Line Not Sewn; colour 800 RED; region sew type Fill Stitch, Direction Manual 0°, Under sewing ticked at its defaults, Pull compensation 0.5 mm, every other region attribute at PE-DESIGN's default (Density 4.5, Step pitch 4.0 mm, Frequency 30 %, Pull compensation 0.0 mm, Feathered edge and Gradation off). Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN moves each row end out by the pull compensation: 40 + 2 × 0.5 mm
pull compensation lengthens the rows only; the first and last rows stay on the edges
PE-DESIGN's count; OpenStitch differs in the row ends, entry travel and locks (stitch-rules F3)
